events.name: Ole 60
events.pleaseNote: This event is Rain or Shine. Chairs are provided for tickets purchased in the Orchestra, Terrace and Lawn sections. Patrons will have no need to bring in their own lawn chairs for seating in these areas. Patrons will only need to bring in their own lawn chairs if tickets are purchased for the obstructed view General Admission section. Please visit www.mcgrathamphitheatre.com to view an event seating chart and for more information regarding prohibited items on the grounds.

accessibility.info: Wheelchair accessible seating would be an opening for the wheelchair itself as the patron's seat.  Companion seating in folding chairs is offered adjacent to the wheelchair.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: The Box Office can be contacted via the U.S. Cellular Center at (319) 362-1729.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Tickets for McGrath Amphitheatre events will be available in advance at the U.S. Cellular Center Box Office, which is open Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM*. Summer hours Memorial Day through Labor Day are 10:00 AM – 4:30 PM. The U.S. Cellular Center Box Office is located at 370 1st Ave NE. The on-site McGrath Amphitheatre Box Office will only be open on event days, two hours before the performance.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: In advance, the U.S. Cellular Center Box Office accepts Cash, Visa, MasterCard, and Discover Card. The on-site McGrath Amphitheatre Box Office will be cash only.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets may be picked up at the on-site McGrath Amphitheatre Box Office no earlier than two hours before the performance. Will Call will be located at the Box Office nearest 3rd Ave. Customers must have a picture ID and the confirmation number to receive their tickets. Customers wishing to pick up their Will Call tickets prior to the day of show must do so at the U.S. Cellular Center Box Office Monday through Friday, 10:00 am – 6:00 pm.

generalInfo.generalRule: No outside food & beverage. No smoking. No pets.

events.name: Cedar Rapids Roughriders vs. Green Bay Gamblers
Bingo Loco (Ages 21+)
events.info: Bingo Loco: The Wildest Bingo Party in Cedar Rapids! Get ready as Bingo Loco is crashing into Cedar City nightlife with a wild mix of bingo, music, and party like nothing you have seen before. Picture this: Energetic MCs, DJ spun throwbacks, mountains of confetti, and crowd hyping CO2 cannons, all while you play high stakes bingo for outrageously fun prizes. Whether you're planning a night out with friends, a birthday celebration, or looking for a unique event in Cedar Rapids, this is the party you do NOT want to miss. Global Hit: After selling out in over 200 cities worldwide, Bingo Loco lands in Cedar Rapids for one of its biggest nights yet. Insane Energy: High octane stage show with rave rounds, dance battles, DJs, and confetti explosions. Crazy Prizes: From Vegas trips to air fryers, inflatable flamingos, Karaoke machines and more. Epic Throwbacks: 80s, 90s, and 00s hits, from ABBA to Britney Spears. Energetic MCs: Dynamic hosts bringing nonstop laughs and energy.
events.pleaseNote: Ages 21+ allowed entry. Anyone younger may not attend.
